    PRIVATE
      # ASDPlasticMaterial3DGlobals.cpp
      OPS_AllASDPlasticMaterial3Ds.cpp
      # generated by gen_ASD_material_definitions_CPP.py (compiled in parallel)
      ASD_material_definitions_0.cpp
      ASD_material_definitions_1.cpp
      ASD_material_definitions_2.cpp
      ASD_material_definitions_3.cpp
      ASD_material_definitions_4.cpp
      ASD_material_definitions_5.cpp
      ASD_material_definitions_6.cpp
      ASD_material_definitions_7.cpp

      AllASDPlasticMaterial3Ds.h

      ASD_material_definitions.h
      ASDPlasticMaterial3D.h        
      ElasticityBase.h    
      YieldFunctionBase.h
      ASDPlasticMaterial3DGlobals.h  
      ASDPlasticMaterial3DTraits.h  
      PlasticFlowBase.h
)

add_subdirectory(ElasticityModels)
add_subdirectory(PlasticFlowDirections)
add_subdirectory(YieldFunctions)
